small_guidance: Enable TF32 in tl.dot (allow_tf32=True) since inputs are fp32 — this should roughly double GEMM throughput on Ada. Also add larger autotune configs tuned for the dominant GPT-2 shapes (M=8192, K=768, N∈{768,2304,3072,50257}) such as BLOCK_M=128/BLOCK_N=128/BLOCK_K=64 num_warps=8 num_stages=4, and BLOCK_M=256/BLOCK_N=64 for the tall-skinny lm_head. Consider casting weights to fp16/bf16 once at init and accumulating in fp32 to leverage tensor cores.
large_guidance: Redesign around fused attention and fp16/bf16 tensor-core GEMMs: (1) replace per-Conv1D GEMM with a fused QKV projection + flash-attention-style kernel (one kernel computes softmax(QK^T)V over the head dimension) to eliminate the materialized [B,H,S,S] attention matrix and its softmax/dropout passes; (2) store weights in fp16/bf16 with fp32 accumulators so tl.dot maps to tensor cores; (3) fuse residual-add + LayerNorm + next projection's epilogue where possible, and fuse GELU into the MLP fc projection's epilogue. Use a persistent-grid GEMM specialized to the few GPT-2 shapes rather than generic autotune.
